metadata.note: 1 run per config (each run spawns 5-7 sub-agents; full pipeline ~10min per run)

analyst_observations: 100% vs 30% pass rate: the skill delivers a 70pp structural advantage — standardized verdict, 12-criterion rubric, vault persistence, lens weights
competitor_section assertion passes for BOTH configs — not discriminating, should be removed or replaced with a stricter check (e.g. 'contains competitor table with Tranco rank data')

business_model classification: without_skill correctly identified 'tool-site' for the salary calculator (1/2 correct) but failed on directory (classified as 'Directory / Marketplace...'). Skill is 2/2.

Time tradeoff is real: 11 minutes per evaluation vs 90 seconds. For a 25-idea vault, that's ~4.5 hours vs ~37 minutes. Consider a 'quick eval' mode that skips competitor deep-dive and runs only 3 research agents.
Token cost: with_skill averages 78K tokens vs 17K without — 4.7x more. At API prices this matters for automated re-evaluation of the full vault.

No Lean Canvas output in either run (has_lean_canvas=false both). The Business Foundation section exists but isn't structured as a Lean Canvas. If BDF integration is important, this should become an assertion.
CLI tools were unavailable for both with_skill runs — all research was estimated. Real CLI runs will produce higher-quality evidence but similar structural pass rates.
